# validate/events_at_multiple — two requests set events_at, but at most one
# request may mark the events producer.

! exec skopos validate -i spec.yml
! stderr .
cmp stdout want_stdout.txt

-- spec.yml --
ir_version: "1"

state:
  url:
    type: url
    default: "http://localhost:9999"

auth:
  none: {}

requests:
  - id: first
    method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}
    events_at: response.body.events
  - id: second
    method: GET
    url: {ref: state.url}
    events_at: response.body.events

pagination:
  none: {}

error:
  mode: standard
-- want_stdout.txt --
requests: error: at most one request may set events_at; got 2
